name: @swao/module-pdf-report
description: SWAO PDF report renderer module (Consultant tier): the pdfkit-backed renderer that turns a formatted text report into a branded, paginated PDF (ADR-0048 modular architecture, Phase 5, #0576). The `report` command + ReportScreen stay in the host (Community keeps text/yaml/view formats); only the PDF rendering moves here. The host injects its branding constants (SWAO version / contacts / landing URL) via the renderer params -- branding is host-only.
